the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Councillor Unkar
the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.text: ...and he says that it's of the greatest urgency.

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Greatest urgency? I don't like urgency. This is quite simply not on.

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Who is this human, Councillor Unkar? What are they doing here?
If the player doees not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: I'm afraid I don't know.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: Oh. Could you make them go away?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. You'll need to come back another time.

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj.text: If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: This is [player name]. They've been helping out in Lovakengj recently.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: Well I've never heard of them. What do they want?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: What do you want human?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: They're looking for a quest.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: A quest? Well we don't have any of those lying around.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Well hang on. Maybe they could help us with this urgent matter.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: What urgent matter?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: The one we were just discussing. The one with the Doors of Dinh.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: Ah yes, the urgent matter with the Doors of Dinh. Very clever Councillor Unkar. You put the human to work. I need a sherry.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: Jorra! Bring me a sherry.

steps.speaker: Jorra
steps.text: Yes Lady Lovakengj.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Human, we have a job for you.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: One of the finest smiths in Lovakengj, Undor, has been investigating issues with the Doors of Dinh. We've just received word that he has found the problem. However, he has requested we send assistance.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Could you go to him and see what help he needs? You'll find him right outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.

steps.player: What brings you to Lovakengj then?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: It's important for the Council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five cities. Although it is the Council that rules, we can only do so with their support.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.

options.text: What are the Doors of Dinh?

steps.player: What are the Doors of Dinh?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: They are a great set of doors built by a legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Unfortunately, although the Doors kept the beast contained for over a thousand years, they've recently started to fail. The master smith, Undor, was sent to investigate.

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: They don't want anything.

steps.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
steps.text: Oh. Could you make them go away then?

steps.speaker: Councillor Unkar
steps.text: Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. If you don't have anything of importance to say, you'll need to come back another time.

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj-t.speaker: Councillor Unkar
the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj-t.text: Human, we have given you a job to do. What else do you need?

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj-t.player: What do you need me to do again?

the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj-t.speaker: Councillor Unkar
the-assembly-talking-to-lady-lovakengj-t.text: Go and speak to Undor and see what he has discovered. You'll find him outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.

options.text: What are the Doors of Dinh?

the-quest-for-the-hammer-talking-to-undo.player: I've been sent to help you.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-talking-to-undo.speaker: Undor
the-quest-for-the-hammer-talking-to-undo.text: I just need to finish this little job. I'll be with you in a minute. While you're waiting, why not talk to that fiery lass? She'll fill you in on the situation here.

options.text: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
I've been sent to help you.

steps.player: I've been sent to help you.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Have you now [laddie/lassie]? I was wondering when they'd send someone.

steps.player: Well here I am. What do you need?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: They all kept saying that the Doors were failing and I kept telling them that was rubbish. Did they listen? Of course they didn't.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Of course not! They were made by Dinh himself, the finest smith this world has ever seen. His work doesn't just fail!

steps.player: But if the Doors aren't failing, what's the issue?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Sabotage!

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: You're right with that one [laddie/lassie]. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: It's not much, but it's enough for that Wintertodt to be able to draw some power into the prison. Probably why them fiery lot have had so much trouble recently.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Repair the damage of course [laddie/lassie]. Now I should be able to fix the issue no problem. The only thing I'm missing is the right tools. That's where you come in.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: I require a hammer!

steps.player: A hammer? Are you seriously telling me that you don't own a hammer?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: What does it look like I'm holding you spoon?! I don't just need any hammer. I need the legendary hammer used by Dinh himself! It's the only tool capable of working this metal.

steps.player: Ahh, I see. So where do I find this hammer?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Back in his prime, Dinh built a great tower. It was known as Dinh's Redoubt and it's where he created all of his finest inventions.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: After Dinh died, some poncey mage thought they'd go and defile his tower. The place has been off limits ever since.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Now I don't know for sure, but I reckon that Dinh's Hammer might still be there.

steps.player: Well there's only one way to find out. Where do I find this tower?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: The Forsaken Tower, as it's now known, can be found west of Lovakengj.

steps.player: Great, I'll be back once I've found that hammer.

options.text: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet [laddie/lassie]?

steps.player: Not yet. Where should I be looking?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: I reckon it's somewhere in Dinh's Redoubt, or The Forsaken Tower, as it's now known. You'll find it west of Lovakengj.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-the-forsaken-to.text: The display case is sealed. It contains an old ornate hammer made of some strange metal. There's a strange panel beneath the display case with some symbols on it.
There is an old generator crank in the crate. You take it.
It's an old steam generator. There's some fuel already in it but it needs cranking up to start it. However, the crank is missing.
You have a crank that can start the generator.

steps.text: You use the crank to start up the generator.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-the-forsaken-to.text: It's an old power grid. It's receiving power, but it is not aligned.

steps.text: You successfully align the power grid.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-the-forsaken-to.text: There's some coolant jugs in the cupboard.

steps.text: You take a 5-gallon jug from the cupboard.
You take an 8-gallon jug from the cupboard.
You take a 5-gallon jug and an 8-gallon jug from the cupboard.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-the-forsaken-to.text: It's an old chemical refinery. It still seems to be in working order.

steps.text: You attempt to activate the refinery but nothing happens. A warning on the control panel reads 'Foreign objects detected, refinery must be cleansed.
You pour the fluid into the refinery. The warning on the control panel disappears.

the-quest-for-the-hammer-the-forsaken-to.text: The display case contains an old ornate hammer made of some strange metal. You take it.

options.text: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet [laddie/lassie]?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Well hand it over then.
You give Dinh's Hammer to Undor.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Look at it! Such a work of art. Dinh never fails to impress. Now that I have this, it shouldn't take me long to fix the Doors.

steps.player: Does this mean the Wintertodt won't be a threat anymore?

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: That should be the case in the long run. I suspect it will take a long time though. The Doors were damaged for a while and the Wintertodt will have gained a lot of power.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: I reckon that magic lot will have to do their fiery tricks for a bit longer before everything is back to normal.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Anyway, I'll get to work fixing the Doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know that the problem has been solved.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Why are you wasting my time?!

options.text: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.

steps.speaker: Undor
steps.text: Now that I have Dinh's Hammer, it shouldn't take me long to fix the Doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: The human seems a bit lost Councillor. Could you help them please.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.player: But I've done what you asked!

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Councillor Unkar
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: We asked them to go and see what help Undor needed at the Doors of Dinh.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: That we did Councillor. Quite right. And what was it that Undor needed?

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.player: Undor had found some damage caused to the Doors of Dinh. He suspected someone had sabotaged them. He asked me to fetch him Dinh's Hammer so that he could fix the Doors.
I found the hammer and gave it to Undor. He should be fixing the Doors as we speak.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Councillor Unkar
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Well this is excellent news. With the Doors fixed, the Wintertodt poses a far smaller threat to Kourend. Well done.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Yes, yes, wonderful stuff. I think I'll have a sherry to celebrate.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Councillor, why is the human still here?

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Councillor Unkar
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: I think they want a reward, Lady Lovakengj.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Well here you go, have this then.

finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.speaker: Lady Vulcana Lovakengj
finishing-up-returning-to-lady-lovakengj.text: Oh. The human is still here.
